The qualifying assessment fee is included in these prices. The credit terms are below. How the work is deliveredToza carries out every engagement in person, at your home or office, with you present and in control of your credentials. Hardening is Toza's own method, developed from public guidance of government security agencies and security vendors. Scope and support Browsers Email Messaging Social and dating Password managers Browsers, email, messaging, social and dating apps, and password managers are reviewed within the agreed device and account scope. Available protections depend on the service. Every option includes essential migration of identities, recovery routes and critical-service access where needed. Historical archives and bulk data migration are scoped separately. Home-network work covers accessible settings and authorized administration; it is recorded separately. Replacement hardware, further connected devices and additional locations are quoted separately. The 60-day question line starts when the protection work is complete. Toza answers through WhatsApp or Signal within one working day. New work is agreed and priced separately; urgent needs follow the urgent-visit terms. If you authorize it, Toza coordinates with your lawyer or family office. Full scope and terms: Conditions. Start with an assessmentPrivate Exposure Assessment · ₪4,000Half a day in person to establish your personal threat model, assess exposure, address urgent issues and set priorities. You keep a written exposure summary whether or not you continue.How the credit worksThe ₪4,000 assessment fee counts in full toward protection whose work begins within 30 days of assessment completion. The assessment and protection are separate decisions. Larger households and ongoing careLarger households, several residences or household staff: a fixed price agreed after the assessment, from ₪90,000.After the 60 days, past clients can choose Annual Care, from ₪12,000 a year.
